name: twilio
title: Twilio
summary: Send, list and fetch SMS, place calls and look up phone numbers over form-encoded bodies, with status callbacks and invalid-number, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Api v2010 only; Lookups v2 is spec/json/twilio_lookups_v2.json in the same repo (sha256 94eecebb7c302115f35ce5842c9a82762495943071051f605c8482ab8c735e6b) and stays hand-written here. The upstream spec declares only success responses (CreateMessage: 201), so the 400 and 429 scenarios need the hand-written contract's error responses.
